title: Input
description: A bare single-line input with sizes, variants and prefix / suffix content. Use TextField for a self-contained labelled field.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Native input attributes and events pass through; className styles the wrapper and ref reaches the <input>.

sizes-variants.title: Sizes and variants
sizes-variants.description: Three sizes and the outline, filled and unstyled variants.

addons.title: Prefix and suffix
addons.description: Decorative content such as icons, symbols or units.

states.title: States
states.description: invalid, disabled and readOnly; inside a FormField the state is inherited.

InputProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl); sets aria-invalid
InputProps.prefix: Decorative content before the text, e.g. an icon or "@"
InputProps.suffix: Decorative content after the text, e.g. a unit
InputProps.className: Class name of the outer wrapper (not the <input>)
